attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Alabama state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per AL tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Alabama Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Alabama tax - Single filer (progressive brackets)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.al_standard_deduction_single sub result.al_exemption_single sub 0 max /al_taxable_income xdef
0 /al_tax xdef
al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_1_limit_single min result.al_bracket_1_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef
al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_1_limit_single gt { al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_2_limit_single min result.al_bracket_1_limit_single sub 0 max result.al_bracket_2_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef } if
al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_2_limit_single gt { al_taxable_income result.al_bracket_2_limit_single sub result.al_bracket_3_rate mul al_tax add /al_tax xdef } if
al_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Alabama tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
